purpose: Machine-readable examples for downstream agents consuming SAP Agent Context bundles, query explanations, consultant answers, citations, evidence, boundaries and gaps without inventing tenant or release proof.

examples.title: Ready context bundle consumer pattern
examples.command: uv run sap-agent-context query --intent fo.workflow --topic supplier-invoice workflow --sap-product s4hana_cloud_public --limit 12 --output build/context-bundles/supplier-invoice-workflow.json
examples.input_focus: A bundle with status=ready, citations, selected items, gaps=[] and quality_signals.gap_count=0.
safe_consumer_behavior: Use the bundle as starter context only.
Preserve item ids, citation ids, access labels and freshness metadata in downstream source maps.
Ask tenant-specific follow-up questions for approval thresholds, role names, system behavior or customer mappings.
must_not_claim: Do not claim tenant configuration truth from a ready bundle.
Do not invent approver roles, thresholds, URLs or customer-specific process variants.

examples.title: Needs-curation context bundle consumer pattern
examples.command: uv run sap-agent-context query --intent fo.reporting --topic generic executive dashboard performance report --limit 12
examples.input_focus: A bundle with status=needs_curation and gaps explaining why final output is blocked.
safe_consumer_behavior: Surface the gaps before any final prose or customer-facing document.
Turn gaps into concrete evidence requests such as KPI names, source query/table/app and freshness expectations.
must_not_claim: Do not produce final dashboard requirements from a needs_curation bundle.
Do not infer KPIs, filters, roles or data sources from generic SAP wording.

examples.title: Query-explain consumer pattern
examples.command: uv run sap-agent-context query-explain "Welke communicatie arrangement security checks en redactie zijn nodig zonder secrets of tenant URL?" --limit 5
examples.input_focus: A query-explain payload with rank_source, matched_terms, claim_ids, source_ids, access and freshness for each ranked result.
safe_consumer_behavior: Explain why the top result matched using rank_source, matched_terms, claim_ids and source_ids.
Keep retrieval evidence separate from tenant-specific proof.
If access is internal_derived or gated, carry the boundary into the downstream response.
must_not_claim: Do not present rank score as SAP correctness.
Do not hide access/freshness/source boundaries behind fluent prose.

examples.title: Consultant-answer consumer pattern
examples.command: uv run sap-agent-context consultant-answer "Welke communicatie arrangement security checks en redactie zijn nodig zonder secrets of tenant URL?" --limit 12
examples.input_focus: A deterministic consultant-answer payload with status=ready, classification=integration_security, citations, evidence and boundary booleans.
safe_consumer_behavior: Preserve citations and evidence ids when reusing the answer.
Show boundary.live_web_validation=false, boundary.expert_certification=false and boundary.tenant_specific_truth=false when implementation decisions matter.
Use the answer as local extracted context, not as target tenant verification.
must_not_claim: Do not claim live SAP Help verification from consultant-answer output.
Do not convert ready into tenant-specific configuration proof.

examples.title: Answer-profile consumer pattern
examples.input_focus: Profile records that name classification status, support_ids, required_answer_citation_ids, positive_fixture_ids and adversarial_probe_ids.
safe_consumer_behavior: Treat profiles as runtime safety contracts rather than SAP content coverage.
Require support ids, positive fixtures and adversarial probes before promoting a ready profile.
Keep generic, unsupported, tenant, release and customizing prompts needs_curation unless a profile explicitly supports them.
must_not_claim: Do not use profile count as proof of SAP domain maturity.
Do not add a ready profile without positive and adversarial coverage.

anti_examples.unsafe_pattern: The downstream agent turns a ready bundle or consultant answer into a concrete customer threshold, Z-role, tenant URL or customizing value.
anti_examples.safe_replacement: State that local context is ready for starter analysis, then ask for target tenant/release/customizing evidence before implementation-ready claims.

anti_examples.unsafe_pattern: The downstream agent omits gaps and writes final prose from status=needs_curation.
anti_examples.safe_replacement: Label the output draft-only, show the gaps first and convert each gap into a curation request.

consumer_rules: Ready is starter context, not tenant truth.
needs_curation is draft-only and must surface gaps before final output.
report_only is a maturity/planning signal, not final bundle readiness.
Citations, source ids, access labels and freshness metadata must survive downstream transformations.
Query-explain ranks evidence; it does not certify SAP correctness.
Consultant-answer is deterministic local extraction; it performs no live web validation, expert certification or tenant-specific verification.
